messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@finexa.com>, ops@finexa.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Readiness council: dedicated GPU capacity review (pool sizing / autoscale / isolation)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking calls last week. The next step your infra team asked for was a focused technical review to walk through how we’d size reserved pools, autoscale behavior, and isolation patterns for Finexa’s PII-sensitive workloads. We’d like to host a short "Readiness Council" to align on:

- target throughput and latency SLOs for live traffic (p95/p99)
- anticipated concurrency and burst patterns (ETL windows, batch jobs, spikes)
- isolation model: single-tenant pools vs. soft isolation + encryption controls
- autoscale policies and warm pool/burst capacity plan
- runbook / fallbacks (model variant routing, regional failover)

Proposed duration: 60 minutes (technical deep-dive + Q/A). Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Sep 1, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Sep 1, 15:00–16:00
- Wed Sep 2, 09:00–10:00

I’ll bring our pool-sizing worksheet and a short topology diagram. Karthik will cover autoscale guardrails and Priyom will outline isolation/configs for Dedicated. Could you confirm which slot works for your infra and whether you want Zoom or a GMeet?

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_capacity_readiness.pdf (short deck), pool-sizing-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa

Could we do Tue Sep 1 at 11:30–12:30 PT instead? That would give us a clean hour between meetings.

Also: can the walkthrough include any specific guidance on KV cache persistence and how that impacts cross-tenant isolation? That’s an ask from our infra/security team.
